pages.text: Her $(item)supply barrels$() hold cannonballs, planks and food, stocked when she's launched. The $(item)sea chest$() and $(item)casks$() are for your own things. They're all ordinary containers, so hoppers and storage mods work with them.
The $(item)water barrel$() works like a cauldron: fill a bucket or a bottle. It refills itself in time.
